people.name: Jokshan
people.line: A son of Abraham and Keturah

people.name: Letushim
people.line: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah

people.name: Leummim
people.line: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah

translations.web: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
translations.bsb: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites, and the Leummites.
translations.kjv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
translations.asv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
